key_insight: Short-wave instabilities in helical vortices saturate weakly at lower linear growth rates but substantially deform the vortex at higher growth rates.
engineering_relevance: Understanding these regimes could inform wind-turbine tip-vortex control strategies aimed at accelerating wake recovery and improving performance.
method: Direct numerical simulations of a helical vortex with axial flow
Elliptic- and curvature-instability disturbances across varied core radii and pitches
Comparison of nonlinear evolution with weakly nonlinear analysis
evidence_signal: The parameter sweep reveals two nonlinear regimes, with higher-growth cases showing stronger deformation and increasing contributions from modes omitted by weakly nonlinear analysis.
watch_item: The abstract reports idealized vortex simulations, not an AI surrogate or validation of control benefits in operating wind turbines.
paper_title: Nonlinear dynamics of short-wave instabilities in a helical vortex within and beyond the weakly nonlinear regime
